name: Ama Mensah
bio: Opened Pose in 2016 after ten years teaching in gyms. Certified in prenatal yoga and still teaches the 7am class most weekdays.
imageAlt: Ama laughing, with long braids and gold hoop earrings

name: Daniel Ortega
bio: A former climber who came to yoga for his shoulders. Teaches arm balances in small, honest steps.
imageAlt: Daniel smiling in a sage green shirt, holding a coffee

name: Mei Chen
bio: Trained in yin and restorative yoga in Taipei. Her classes are quiet, warm and very well propped.
imageAlt: Mei holding a seated pigeon variation on a mat in a white room

name: Walter Brooks
bio: Started yoga at sixty-one for his back. Now teaches the classes he wishes he had found first.
imageAlt: Walter, silver-haired and smiling, arms folded in a navy sweater
